layout: s0 = state at the branch point; a1/a2 = the two move actions held `lag` steps; s1/s2 = the two real outcomes. Built by scripts/collect_counterfactual.py.
what_it_measures: On 43% of pairs the two actions produce outcomes <0.5 world units apart -- the game ignores the command. On the other 57% they separate by a mean of 21.4 units. Any action-conditioning metric must be scored on the sensitive subset.
